_readme: The only place project-specific facts live. Every field here is explained in profile.schema.json (canonical) — read that file alongside this one. Fill in every TODO, delete sections you genuinely do not have (only 'project', 'adapters', 'source' and 'docs' are required), then run `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/doctor.py"` before trusting anything else. Never put an absolute path, a client name, or a hostname in this file.

project.name: jikan-rest
project.audience: technical users consuming read-only MyAnimeList data via JSON; also developers/ops of the API itself
project.framework: Laravel 13 (PHP 8.4, MongoDB via laravel-mongodb, Octane/RoadRunner, Scout native Typesense optional). Read-only JSON API by design: no auth, no sessions, no CSRF, no Blade.

provenance._readme: How each field above got its value: 'inferred' (a survey or a skill proposed it — authoritative for nothing), 'declared' (a human wrote it), 'approved' (a human reviewed an inferred value and ratified it). Optional, and starting empty is honest: doctor.py reports every field with no entry here as UNTRUSTED and prints the ratified-of-total count on every run, so an empty block reads as '0 of N ratified' rather than as approval. There is no 'contradicted' state to write — doctor computes it when an approved or declared field stops matching the tree. Add `verifiedAgainst.commit` (a git SHA) when you ratify a field: staleness is measured in diffs, not days, and there is deliberately no expiry date.
